name: sql-crud
title: 关系数据库实验：检验数据登记与查询（建库 + 增删改查 + SQL 统计）

assertions.name: 原始行数报对（真的读过三张表）
assertions.expr: out.profile.raw_rows.patients === expected.profile.raw_rows.patients && out.profile.raw_rows.visits === expected.profile.raw_rows.visits && out.profile.raw_rows.labs === expected.profile.raw_rows.labs

assertions.name: 清洗口径一致：入库行数
assertions.expr: out.loaded.patients === expected.loaded.patients && out.loaded.visits === expected.loaded.visits && out.loaded.labs === expected.loaded.labs

assertions.name: 清洗口径一致：丢弃的脏行计数
表结构是关系式的（每表有主键、至少两张表声明了外键）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.schema.tables) && out.schema.tables.length >= 3 && out.schema.tables.filter((t) => Array.isArray(t.primary_key) && t.primary_key.length > 0).length >= 3 && out.schema.tables.filter((t) => Array.isArray(t.foreign_keys) && t.foreign_keys.length > 0).length >= 2

assertions.name: 外键约束真的生效（引用不存在就诊的报告被拒绝）
增删改都真的落到库里
assertions.expr: out.crud.deleted_labs === expected.crud.deleted_labs && out.crud.updated_visits === expected.crud.updated_visits && out.crud.inserted_visits === expected.crud.inserted_visits && out.crud.inserted_labs === expected.crud.inserted_labs && out.crud.final_labs === expected.crud.final_labs && out.crud.final_visits === expected.crud.final_visits

assertions.name: q1 超标患者名单正确（三表 JOIN + 排序）
q2 各科室统计正确（GROUP BY，按科室名升序）
q3 检验次数统计正确（GROUP BY + HAVING）
图与说明齐全（至少 1 张，含一句话结论）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.figures) && out.figures.length >= 1 && out.figures.every((f) => f && typeof f.path === 'string' && f.path.trim() !== '' && typeof f.takeaway === 'string' && f.takeaway.trim().length >= 10)
